provenance.source_title: Why It Sucks to Be an INHERITED Wife (in the Mongol Empire)

examples.psychological_goal: 第一秒用仪式性场景把观众指派为当事人，建立零铺垫沉浸
examples.expression_mechanism: Picture this + 第二人称 + 三个连续现在进行时的场景白描
examples.example_text: Picture this. You are at a funeral. You are wearing black. You are dabbing your eyes with a tissue.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'想象这个画面+你是某人'的短句连发，在前五秒完成身份指派与场景搭建
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景与身份设定

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句反转把观众从'哀悼者'贬为'被分配的资产'，完成开场最大冲击
examples.expression_mechanism: 法律被动语态 + 年龄落差的具象化 + 荒诞的合规措辞
examples.example_text: You are legally being transferred to your 20-year-old stepson to be his brand new legally binding wife.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你被合法地转让给某人'的被动句式，让制度羞辱听起来像一纸公文
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该人物关系与法律设定

examples.psychological_goal: 用三连程度副词为本期主题命名并定性，承诺内容的离谱程度
examples.expression_mechanism: 三个副词-形容词组合并列 + 主题正式命名
examples.example_text: the deeply uncomfortable, highly bureaucratic and completely mind-boggling tradition of the inherited wife.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'极度X、高度Y、完全Z'的副词堆叠为一个陌生主题定调
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该主题名称与措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 在进入制度讲解前，先把观众的既有想象宣布为作废
examples.expression_mechanism: To understand why + 现代词汇定性 + throw out everything you know 的清空句式
examples.example_text: To understand why your dating life in the Mongol Empire was an absolute bureaucratic nightmare
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'要理解X，先丢掉你以为你知道的一切'的转场公式开启认知重构段
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用该句式；清空的对象必须是观众真实持有的刻板印象

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个现代职位头衔瞬间完成对该群体真实地位的认知反转
examples.expression_mechanism: essentially the + 现代高管头衔 + of the empire 的类比断言
examples.example_text: the Mongol women were essentially the chief operating officers of the empire.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'他们本质上是某现代职位'的一句类比完成群体地位反转
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该职位类比；类比头衔必须与真实分工相符

examples.psychological_goal: 把婚姻制度翻译成企业并购，在笑点中完成规则讲解
examples.expression_mechanism: literal + hardcore + 现代商业术语 的错位断言
examples.example_text: in the Mongol Empire, a marriage was a literal hardcore corporate merger.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'在这里，X其实是一笔Y'的句式把陌生制度一秒翻译成现代商业逻辑
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该比喻；翻译必须准确对应制度的真实运作方式

examples.psychological_goal: 用最平静的公文语气陈述最窒息的规则，让制度恐怖自己说话
examples.expression_mechanism: automatically legally inherited 的自动化被动句式
examples.example_text: when a man died, his wives were automatically legally inherited by his closest male relative.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'某人死后，某物自动归某人'的流水线句式呈现非人化规则
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该规则内容与措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个现代家庭场景类比为假想代入的心理恐怖盖章，笑点与寒意并存
examples.expression_mechanism: the absolute worst + 最高级叠用 + 现代节日场景 的定性句
examples.example_text: It is the absolute worst, most deeply toxic Thanksgiving dinner scenario imaginable.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在恐怖代入之后用一句现代场景类比收束，让观众笑着感到不适
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景类比；最高级必须有前文细节支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句话把叙事从通则切换到真实罪案级案例，并自称'真实犯罪故事'
examples.expression_mechanism: Let me introduce you to + 类型片框架自封 的转场句
examples.example_text: Let me introduce you to the main characters of our true crime story.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在案例开场用一句介绍句式为接下来的故事重新定性类型
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类型标签；类型框架必须与内容真实匹配

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句判词揭示主角的制胜动作：把制度推崇的美德变成武器
examples.expression_mechanism: weaponized + 美德名词 + against + 权力顶点 的反转定性
examples.example_text: She weaponized the concept of motherhood against the most powerful man on earth.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'她把X武器化对抗Y'的句式，一句话点破以柔克刚的策略本质
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该策略内容与措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 用两句短句呈现对照策略的爆发：不等被分配，直接接管全局
examples.expression_mechanism: 动词劫持董事会 + 自封临时负责人 的连续短句动作
examples.example_text: She completely hijacks the board of directors. She steps up and declares herself the temporary acting CEO of the Mongol Empire.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'劫持会议架构+自封职位'的两句动作白描呈现夺权瞬间
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该企业词汇组合与情境

examples.psychological_goal: 用清洗清单的排比与一个委婉化黑话制造冷峻的黑色幽默
examples.expression_mechanism: fired, exiled, or mysteriously stopped breathing 的三连升级与委婉语
examples.example_text: every single bureaucrat who had ever disrespected her in the past was immediately fired, exiled, or mysteriously stopped breathing.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在清算清单的末尾用一个轻描淡写的委婉语完成黑色幽默落点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该委婉语；黑话必须与前两项形成程度落差

examples.psychological_goal: 用两句对称短句完成由盛转衰的背叛转折
examples.expression_mechanism: to destroy X, he had to take out Y 的目标拆解句式
examples.example_text: He wanted to destroy his mother's power. And he knew that to destroy his mother, he had to take out her chief of staff.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'要摧毁X，必须先除掉Y'的逻辑拆解句把权谋转折讲得一清二楚
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该人物关系；拆解必须基于已建立的权力结构

examples.psychological_goal: 在极刑描述的最黑暗处主动收声，把恐怖交给观众脑补
examples.expression_mechanism: I will let your imagination figure out 的想象留白句
examples.example_text: I will let your imagination figure out exactly what that means.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在尺度边缘用一句留白句收声：不描述，反而更恐怖且更安全
examples.negative_instruction: 不要滥用留白；它只对已经铺垫充分的恐怖细节有效

examples.psychological_goal: 用一组对照短句为隐忍线的制胜打法定性
examples.expression_mechanism: She didn't act like X. She acted like Y. 的否定-肯定对仗
examples.example_text: She didn't act like a dictator. She acted like an angel investor.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'她不像X，她像Y'的对仗句为人物策略一秒定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该比喻组合；Y必须与人物真实打法相符

examples.psychological_goal: 完成认知升华：赢下权力游戏靠的不是对抗，而是一封礼貌的拒绝信
examples.expression_mechanism: not by fighting the system, but by + 反差动作 的转折点题
examples.example_text: she won the ultimate game of thrones, not by fighting the system, but by using a polite human resources email
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'不是靠X，而是靠一个反差极大的小动作'的句式完成主题升华
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该表述；反差动作必须是故事中真实发生的制胜动作

examples.psychological_goal: 把历史处境翻译成观众的日常庆幸，完成情绪收束
examples.expression_mechanism: it could always be worse + 古今对照断言 的收束句
examples.example_text: it could always be worse. Your corporate acquisition doesn't require you to legally marry the new CEO.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'总会更糟：你的现代版本不需要承受X'的对照句为全片收尾
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该对照内容；现代版本必须是观众真实经历的日常
